context: Field report from a taxdome session: agent did not use find_symbol to read specific chapters after receiving a class outline / doc TOC. find_symbol on a class dumped 57 KB (outline + merged RSpec bodies) and the agent grepped the saved dump; a doc section lookup returned a TOC listing only the queried hash; agent fell back to Read.

method.style: paper eval — one subagent per suite, all cases in one prompt, agent writes next tool calls, no execution
method.before_fix: search-cascade.md at main HEAD 70ecf734f + pre-fix find_symbol description
method.no_rule: tool list with pre-fix find_symbol description only
method.contamination_note: The PreToolUse Agent hook appends the INSTALLED (pre-fix) subagent search suffix to every eval prompt, so no_rule = production subagent without cascade, not a clean zero.

audit_findings.F1: Mode A table + After-Search row claimed find_symbol(symbol: ClassName) returns 'full class outline + all method bodies'; real class outline carries member symbolIds only.
audit_findings.F2: Doc chunk row claimed parentSymbolId is doc:<hash>; it is the doc path.
audit_findings.F3: No rule for oversized results saved to a file or for treating outline/TOC lines as addresses; agent grepped the dump.
audit_findings.F4: Describe-scope row passed chunkType to find_symbol, which has no such param.

product_defects_fixed_alongside: resolveSymbols rendered a doc TOC whenever >1 chunks shared a parent, losing multi-chunk section content (doc:447d443a09c8).
Class outline required a class-level chunk; member-only scrolls returned bodies (TS StatsCache).
Class query merged all RSpec chunks with parentSymbolId = class into one ~52 KB result (fixed in iteration 2 by excluding test chunks from class queries).
product_defects_deferred: Oversized test-scope split gives every example the same symbolId (Ruby + TS) — a per-example id fix was built, then reverted because it needs a chunking bump + --force reindex; tracked as epic tea-rags-mcp-phftd.

cases.prompt: Class outline of Platform::Async::Operation::Worker in hand (ids only, chunkCount 16); explain failure handling.
cases.expected: find_symbol(symbol: Worker#mark_failed) and/or Worker#perform. NOT Read, NOT grep, NOT re-query class.

cases.prompt: File outline of reranker.ts in hand; how are adaptive bounds computed?
Show me how class PaymentProcessor handles refunds (no prior results).
cases.expected: find_symbol(symbol: PaymentProcessor) → outline (no bodies) → find_symbol per refund member id, unconditionally.
cases.before_fix: FAIL — expected refund body inline per cascade, drill only 'if bodies missing'

cases.prompt: Doc TOC with doc:<hash> lines in hand; what does the doc say about retries?
find_symbol(Billing::Invoice) output saved to file, preview shows outline; show refund logic.
cases.expected: find_symbol(symbol: Billing::Invoice#refund). NOT grep/Read the dump.

cases.prompt: Same saved outline with tests: lines; which refund scenarios are tested?
cases.expected: find_symbol(symbol: <tests: id>) and/or find_symbol(relativePath: spec) → drill. NOT grep/Read the dump.

cases.prompt: (RU) outline Acme::User in hand; покажи нормализацию email.
[subagent: explore] Explain StatsCache persistence format, load and save.
cases.expected: outline (symbol or relativePath) → find_symbol StatsCache#load + #save, unconditionally.
cases.before_fix: FAIL — expected bodies from class lookup, drill only 'if names only'

cases.prompt: [subagent: task-agent] Read ONLY the Migration section of a spec doc.
Doc chunk with parentSymbolId docs/signals.md; list all sections.
cases.expected: find_symbol(relativePath: docs/signals.md) (or symbol: doc path). NOT symbol: doc:<chunk hash> expecting TOC.

iteration_2.reason: User rejected `tests:` lines in the class outline (option b) — incomplete, convention-bound link that forced a chunking bump + --force reindex. Switched to option (a): class query excludes test chunks; tests of a class via hybrid_search testFile only. Chunker per-example ids reverted; per-example test addressing moved to epic tea-rags-mcp-phftd.
iteration_2.suite: after_fix only (regression slice): E3, E5, E6 (rewritten), E11 (new), C1, C4

cases.expected: find_symbol(class) → outline → drill refund member ids

cases.prompt: Saved outline preview without test lines; show refund logic.
Billing::Invoice outline in hand (no test lines); which refund scenarios are tested?
cases.expected: hybrid_search(query: Billing::Invoice refund, testFile: only). NOT grep dump, NOT expect tests in class outline.

cases.prompt: [subagent: task-agent] Find the specs that exercise Platform::Async::Operation::Worker#perform.
cases.expected: hybrid_search(testFile: only). NOT ripgrep, NOT find_symbol(class).

iteration_2.known_limitation: find_symbol(<Top>.<scope>) on an oversized split scope still returns every part merged (shared symbolId) — epic tea-rags-mcp-phftd.

key_insight: Clean synthetic prompts that hand the model an outline are solved without rules; the with-rule failures were CAUSED by the stale 'outline + all method bodies' claim (E3, E8), and the no-rule failure is exactly the field-report behaviour (grep the saved dump, E6). Delta is below the +50pp target because the real failure mode lives in product defects (TOC-instead-of-content, 52 KB merged specs, shared test ids) that no instruction can route around — those were fixed in code, not text.
